metadata.title: Swagger Editor
metadata.description: Design, edit, and document your OpenAPI specifications.

about.title: About
about.description: An analogue of Swagger, for creating, editing, validating, and viewing OpenAPI specifications. The user can work with API documentation, view endpoints, execute requests, generate cURL commands, and view request history.

course.title: About RS School Course
